messages:
incident-bot: P1 - Inference degradation detected (eu-central-1 dedicated pool). Affected customers: enterprise tier. Paging @eng-oncall-aaron and @mike-sre. Incident: https://redwood/status/INC-3605

eng-oncall-aaron: Oncall here. Observed increased 5xx from dedicated nodes after a rolling kernel update. Triage in progress, spinning up fallback pool.

mike-sre: Joining. Autoscaler hit throttling on reserved pool, KV cache warmup spiking CPU. Rolling back last deployment to candidate-2026-03-17.

jordan-cs: Which enterprise accounts are impacted? Need a tailored customer notification + contact routing list.

eng-oncall-aaron: Short list from logs (accounts with sustained 5xx >5min):
```
- Novara Health (novara@example.com)
- Aeon Consortium (ops@aeon.com)
- Orion Health (oncall@orion-health.com)
- Cascade Financial (alerts@cascade.co)
```

leah-ops: Thanks. Drafting customer message now. Will use channel routing: primary email -> account owner, fallback -> enterprise-ops slack.

sara-product: Draft for customers (short):
"We are experiencing a partial degradation of Redwood Dedicated inference in eu-central impacting request throughput and occasional 5xx errors. Our engineers are rolling back a recent runtime update; mitigation in progress. No data loss. Next update in 30m or earlier. Contact: jordan-cs@redwood.com"

jordan-cs: Suggest adding specific impact lines per customer for enterprise outreach. e.g., Novara: 'affects contact-routing and customer-initiated API calls' etc.

mike-sre: Rollback initiated -> success on 3/4 subpools. Traffic shifting to fallback pool. Monitoring KV cache warmup; CPU trending down.

eng-oncall-aaron: Status page update (publish): "Partial degradation mitigated; rollback started. Some enterprise customers may have experienced increased errors between 10:12-10:28 UTC. We're monitoring for stabilization."

jordan-cs: I'll send tailored emails now. Copy of internal comms template (for support teams):
```
Subject: Incident - Redwood Dedicated (eu-central) - [CustomerName]
Hi [Customer Contact],
We're investigating a partial degradation affecting your dedicated inference pool. Impact: intermittent 5xx and increased latency for requests initiated between 10:12-10:28 UTC. Mitigation: rollback of runtime update in progress, no data loss. ETA for stabilization: 30m. For urgent questions call +1-415-555-0102 or reply to this thread.
Regards,
Redwood Incident Team
```

leah-ops: Running account handoff: @sara-product -> craft external phrasing; @jordan-cs -> send emails; @mike-sre -> confirm full pool recovery; @eng-oncall-aaron -> close incident when stable.

sara-product: Posted status page and customer emails sent to the list above. Fingers crossed. :pray:

mike-sre: All subpools green 10:42 UTC. Error rate back to baseline. Leaving monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:

eng-oncall-aaron: Incident resolved -> moving to postmortem. Assigning action items: rollback gate added, autoscaler quota alert tuned, postmortem owner: mike-sre.

jordan-cs: Notifying customers that a follow-up postmortem will be provided within 48h and offering dedicated sync calls if needed.
